chats.typed: best nas for backing up iphone photos with immich
queries: Immich official documentation hardware requirements docker compose database backup mobile iOS background uploads Synology NAS 2026
chats.answer:
For backing up iPhone photos using Immich, I'd recommend a 4-bay NAS with an Intel CPU, at least 8 GB RAM, and SSD storage for Immich's database.

Immich is more demanding than a typical NAS photo app because it handles thumbnails, video transcoding, facial recognition, and machine-learning searches.

My top choices are UGREEN NASync DXP4800 Plus, Synology DS925+, and QNAP TS-464. The best one depends on whether you prioritize Immich performance, easy maintenance, or flexibility.

Best NAS options for Immich

UGREEN NASync DXP4800 Plus 4-Bay NAS Enclosure

Best overall for Immich

Intel 5-core processor, 4 drive bays, NVMe slots, and 10GbE networking. My first choice for running Immich directly on the NAS.

QNAP TS-464 4-Bay NAS Enclosure

Best flexible alternative

Intel Celeron quad-core, 4 bays, dual 2.5GbE, and NVMe slots. Good Docker support and hardware video acceleration.

Synology DS925+ 4-Bay NAS Enclosure

Best for NAS management and backups

$889.99

Mature DSM software, snapshots, and backup tools. Upgrade its default 4 GB RAM for Immich. No integrated GPU for hardware transcoding.

Current listed US enclosure prices, excluding hard drives and SSDs.
My recommended setup

Suggested Immich storage architecture

I'd configure it with 16 GB RAM, two NAS-rated HDDs in a mirror to start, and a 500 GB NVMe SSD for the database and application data. Keep a separate backup of the photo library and database, because RAID alone is not a backup. Immich specifically recommends local SSD storage for PostgreSQL. 
Immich
+1

One important iPhone limitation: iOS controls when Immich can upload in the background. Enable Background App Refresh and open Immich periodically, particularly during the initial photo upload. No NAS can completely eliminate this iOS limitation.
